dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: How far is the university from here?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ ˈfɑːr ɪz ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti frəm ˈhɪr?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Not far. It's a ten-minute walk.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈfɑːr. ɪts ə ˌtɛn ˌmɪnɪt ˈwɔːk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! From my house, it's a two-hour bus ride.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! frəm maɪ ˈhaʊs, ɪts ə ˌtuː ˌaʊər ˈbʌs ˌraɪd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Two hours? That's a long time! This neighborhood is very convenient.
dialogue.reading: ˈtuː ˈaʊərz? ðæts ə ˈlɔːŋ ˈtaɪm! ðɪs ˈneɪbərhʊd ɪz ˈvɛri kənˈviːniənt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, there's a small one. It's a five-minute walk.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ðɛrz ə ˈsmɔːl ˈwʌn. ɪts ə ˌfaɪv ˌmɪnɪt ˈwɔːk.
